r0.t: Thighs. Cramp-like pain in the hip-joint, after anxiety, waking at night

r1.t: Twitching of the muscles in inner thigh, with anxiety and faint feeling

r2.t: Periodical, nervous (spasmodic) drawing, from the hip to the knee, causing screams

r3.t: Great weakness in the muscles of the thighs with anxiousness

r5.t: Anxiety* with spasmodic drawing in the right leg

r6.t: Spasms in lower limbs, with or between attacks of mania

r9.t: Jerking of the legs with anxiety

r10.t: Starts from sleep, with involuntary jerks of the left leg

r11.t: Sensations and Conditions. On seeing anything to vex her, feels it in the limbs

r12.t: Restlessness in the legs when standing, with anxiety

r13.t: Lower limb gets asleep, feeling in the joint as if dead, most towards evening, with great anxiety

r14.t: Heaviness, as of lead in the legs after vexation

r15.t: Lassitude and fatigue of the lower extremities, with dazed feeling as if drunk

r16.t: Weakness of lower limbs, as if unable to support the body, uses wrong words when speaking

r17.t: Great weakness in the feet and joints after walking in open air, cannot do mental work

r18.t: Feeling of anxiety and weakness in the right leg when walking

r19.t: Weakness in the feet, with melancholy

r20.t: Weakness in the feet, with melancholy, with vexation

r21.t: Weakness in the feet, with melancholy, after abdominal anxiety

r22.t: Unable to stand on her feet, delirium

r23.t: Tired feeling in the thighs and knee-joints, ill humor, no inclination to think

r24.t: Heaviness of the legs, with ill humor

r28.t: Tearing in the bones, causing loud moaning

r29.t: Jerks in the legs, w r aking from sleep

r30.t: Shuddering in the legs with inclination to laugh

r32.t: Unsteadiness in the knees, compels to lie down after a fright, caused by sudden surprises

r33.t: Mind And Disposition, trembling of one knee and foot, with eager expectation

r34.t: Mind And Disposition, tired feeling in the knees, with mental activity

r35.t: Mind And Disposition, knees give way after the least vexation

r36.t: Mind And Disposition, knees give way after the least vexation, after a fit of rage

r37.t: Mind And Disposition, knees give way after the least vexation, in delirium

r38.t: Mind And Disposition, pain in knees, with restlessness

r40.t: Mind And Disposition, pain, as if beaten in left knee, with anxious heat

r41.t: Mind And Disposition, terrible pain in knees, with moaning and whimpering

r42.t: Mind And Disposition, a terribly disagreeable feeling of short duration in the knee

r43.t: Mind And Disposition, a stitch in the knee when falling asleep

r59.t: Feet, languid feeling in the feet, not well humored
